title: Weekly Recap: Hashrate Milestones & Target
hook: Weekly recap: hashrate and target in three points.

scenes.narration: One terahash per second is one trillion hashes per second.
A block's hash must be at or below the target, and a lower target is harder.
Every two thousand sixteen blocks the target is adjusted to keep blocks near ten minutes.

cta: Which point do you want next? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Hashrate is the guesses per second, and the target sets how hard it is to win.
